items.content_html: AI Image Studio is a lightweight React app for rapid image-ideation. Upload a PNG/JPG (auto-downscaled if large), enter a prompt, choose a style, and see a live summary before generating. A mocked API simulates latency, errors, retries with backoff, and aborts, while the last five results persist as a clickable history.
